learning_outcomes.text: Determine the force and moment acting on machine elements. Calculate stresses and deformations for static and dynamic conditions.
Define shafts and axles, calculate / perform strength control according to design parameters.
Define shaft-hub connections (key connections and interference fit), calculate / perform strength control.
Classify materials used in machine elements and determine their mechanical properties.

syllabus_topics: Machine Elements according to their functions, material definition and classification
Force, moment and stresses effective on machine elements
Strength Calculation: Static and variable loading
Shafts and axles: Cylindrical shafts, profile shafts, cam shafts, crankshafts
Threaded connections: Definition, classification, areas of use, standards
Threaded connections: Force-moment transmission, strength calculation
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on a midterm exam weighted at 40% and a final exam weighted at 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: Shigley, JE., Mechanical Engineering Design, McGraw-Hill,1986.
